title: Principal Medical Device Quality Auditor
description_plain:
Lead quality management audits of medical device facilities.

Employer-Mandated Credential Prerequisite:
- Accredited ISO 13485 Lead Auditor Certification is strictly required by employer for lead auditor client assignments (employer contractual qualification, not statutory licensing).

Experience Expectation:
- Approximately 10 years of experience in medical device quality auditing under FDA 21 CFR Part 820 (preferred experience level, not an automatic statutory ineligibility gate).
